pairs.evidence: lib/foundry/strips/store.ts:432 The destructive strips commit (it deletes rejected media) verifies its preview token only when a caller supplies one, so binding the commit to what the operator saw depends on the caller even though triage.ts:35 promises it unconditionally. The Dojo's commitCycle takes no binding at all.

techniques.evidence: lib/foundry/strips/store.ts:432 The token is optional. The one production caller (lib/decision/v1/sources/strips.ts:298) passes it, but the door itself accepts a commit that is bound to no preview.
lib/foundry/training/store.ts:313 The Dojo commit re-reads verdicts and blind picks at commit time with no token or digest of what was shown at the gate.
lib/foundry/strips/author.ts:4 Work authority (the agent turn) is separated from verdict authority (the operator's triage). The agent's look at its sheet is only a pre-filter.
lib/foundry/training/blind.ts:8 The human judges blind before the judges are unmasked, and BLIND_FLOOR (line 19) marks too few pairs as unmeasurable rather than as a verdict.
